items.headline: Average DAM (Southern proxy) MCP: Rs 2551.11/MWh
items.detail: Day-ahead market average clearing price for 2026-07-05 was Rs 2551.11/MWh across 96 15-min blocks (range Rs 199.92-8999.3/MWh).

raw_values.region_note: Karnataka has no standalone day-ahead price; this uses the IEX Southern-region area clearing price as a proxy (see scope-note.md).

items.headline: Peak-hour (18:00-24:00) MCP premium: +52.4% vs daily avg
items.detail: Peak-hour average MCP was Rs 3889.12/MWh vs the day's overall average of Rs 2551.11/MWh, a +52.4% divergence.

raw_values.region_note: Karnataka has no standalone day-ahead price; this uses the IEX Southern-region area clearing price as a proxy (see scope-note.md).

items.headline: Wide intraday MCP spread: 345% of daily average
items.detail: Max-min spread of Rs 8999.3 - Rs 199.92 = 345% of the daily average, indicating high intraday volatility.
